name: Aksu

queries.query: Aksu China cadastral parcel map official natural resources cadastral service
queries.result: Results identified the official Xinjiang Natural Resources Department and its Xinjiang natural-resources map-service platform, plus official descriptions of the Digital Aksu geospatial data service platform. No anonymous public parcel ID plus geometry endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: 阿克苏市 自然资源局 不动产登记 地图 地籍 官方
queries.result: Official Chinese-language results describe the Aksu geospatial platform, Aksu-area natural-resources digital land monitoring, Xinjiang property-registration procedures, and an Aksu-area natural-resources contact. They did not expose an anonymous parcel feature response or public schema/CRS.

registryBasis: Official sources establish Aksu-area natural-resources custody and a Digital Aksu geospatial platform, but no city-local public registry viewer or anonymous parcel geometry response was verified; custody/platform description is not treated as registry integration evidence.

officialSources.observation: Xinjiang Natural Resources Department describes the Digital Aksu geospatial data service platform as integrating two-/three-dimensional data services, GIS analysis, natural-resources one-map applications and standardized interfaces for departmental sharing; no public parcel endpoint is listed.

Official Xinjiang source says Aksu-area natural resources uses the Digital Aksu platform for full-coverage agricultural-land monitoring and spatial data integration; this is an institutional data-platform description, not an open cadastral parcel API.
Official Aksu municipal government-services portal loaded over HTTPS and exposed public service/navigation pages, but no anonymous cadastral parcel layer or geometry service was found.

requests.outcome: HTTP 200; public portal HTML retrieved. No parcel viewer/API route identified.

HTTP 200; public map/service shell and current JavaScript bundle retrieved. Bundle exposed general government-service APIs and map demonstrations, but no public cadastral parcel layer/schema/CRS.
HTTP 404; bounded public search route did not return a result payload. No retry with credentials or private parameters.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Aksu-area natural-resources and Digital Aksu geospatial data services described by official Xinjiang sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Institutional/platform description only; no anonymous parcel geometry service verified.

notes: Exact WUP point retained in latitude/longitude order. No exact-point hit/miss inference was made. A map extent miss, timeout, login wall, unusable UI or absent public endpoint is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained. Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission.
